canonical_project: Tui Samoa Futuna cable landing station (Leava, Futuna)
owner: SPT-WF; Tui Samoa cable system (SSCC/consortium with AFD/EU funding for WF branch)
notes: AFD (A) and La 1ère (B) confirm a Futuna landing station installed (Oct-Nov 2017) and operational with Tui Samoa (RFS April 2018 per SPT-WF); village-level placement at Leava (Sigave precinct, north-west Futuna) per GeoCables cable tracker (C). Classified telecom_cable_station per WF methodology; Leava SPT service point itself is not a data center. No commercial colo or named government DC evidence in Sigave.
